name: GrainPad
description: Live-capture granular pad for NTS-3. Touch freezes up to 3 s of AUDIO IN into a grain cloud. X/FEEL: sparse ↔ dense. Y = octave mix. ENV = grain attack/release. SYNC / SPRD / HPF / REVS. MIX = dry/wet.

params.name: FEEL
params.detail: Left: sparser stitches. Right: dense overlapping cloud

params.name: SPRD
params.detail: Random stereo width (0 = mono, max = hard L/R)

params.name: HPF
params.detail: High-pass on the granular wet path (~60 Hz–10 kHz)

params.name: REVS
params.detail: Probability that a grain plays in reverse
